name: ida-assistant
description: Project-scoped, lazy multi-agent MCP scheduler for IDA Pro 9.4.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze project binaries with short, isolated IDA sessions.
interface.longDescription: IDA Assistant keeps analysis state under each project's .ida directory. Different binaries run in isolated workers, while each MCP connection uses a short active-session workflow and existing paths are reused automatically.
defaultPrompt: Open this sample in IDA and summarize key functions.
Find string xrefs and decompile the callers.
Map imports, functions, and suspicious paths.
